email.title: Email

register.question: How do I register on the platform?
register.answer: Click the "Create a profile" button, choose a profile type and fill in the form. It only takes a few minutes!

free.question: Is listing services free?
free.answer: Yes! Using the platform and listing services is free of charge.

review.question: How do I leave a review?
review.answer: You can leave a review after a request is completed: open the provider's profile or the request, give a rating and, if you wish, write a comment.

password.question: What should I do if I forgot my password?
password.answer: Write to the administration on Telegram or to the support email — we will help you regain access to your account after verifying your identity.

delete.question: How do I delete my account?
